Announcements
  • Official February 2021 Member of the Month is Grim - Stanley We have got a brand-new member to the member of the month club. The member known as Grim has been named the member of the month of February 2021. Have you congratulated them yet? If not then make sure you go and show your support in this thread.
  • Connection Errors, Memory Problems - Omniscient Several users have reported experiencing issues accessing the website. Omniscient addressed this, writing that Hack Forums' server has been experiencing some hardware issues. If the situation worsens, parts of the server will be replaced.
  • HF Changing Names - Omniscient Is it time for Hack Forums to get a new name? Would you use a forum called Money Forums? Following increased online censorship against websites that talk about hacking, Omniscient is considering the possibility of changing the forum's name. Share your opinion on the thread.
  • Official Tiktok Embed - Xerotic TikTok has been taking the world by storm. The platform allows users to upload short video clips where they usually do some kind of dance to music. There are more than a few education and comedy videos as well. TikTok embedding is now supported on Hack Forums, meaning you can easily share TikToks in the convo room or on a thread.
Informational Threads
  • Four Top Russian Cybercrime Forums Hacked - 618C In the weeks running up to this edition of the HF News, several Russian cybercrime forums were hacked, with one being hit around March 4. Many speculate that the attacks originated from a government agency, instead of random hackers, due to how they targetted and infiltrated multiple major forums for crime in such a short space of time.
  • John Mcafee indicted for crypto pump & dump fraud - Iconical The founder of McAfee, John McAfee, has been charged with conspiracy to commit fraud and money laundering. The federal prosecutors allege that he lied about several tokens and failed to disclose his financial stake in others, while promoting them on his Twitter page.

  • WHAT WOULD YOU DO IF YOU WERE OMNIPOTENT ? - ilcaneee To be omnipotent is to have unlimited power and great influence. You might consider a God to be omnipotent. What would you do if there was no end to your power and you were able to control anything and everything?
  • How many of you look like this right now? - shreder If you spend a lot of time in front of your computer, you might end up with poor posture. Do you hunch over or do you sit up straight? Perhaps you look like the picture in shreder's thread. It is great to be self-aware. Check out the thread and reply with how you are currently positioned.

AWS Ethereum Support Amazon Web Services announced on March 2 that they are making Ethereum available as an option on Amazon Managed Blockchain. The move allows customers on AWS to easily create and deploy Ethereum nodes that are able to fully connect to the main Ethereum network, as well as the test networks. Through the Amazon Managed Blockchain service, it is easy to keep track of node health and performance, ensuring that blockchain applications experience near to no downtime. Ethereum upgrades and updates are handled automatically and unhealthy nodes get replaced on the go. One of the primary goals of AWS is to provide customers with an easy way to create scalable products. This mission continues with this announcement as there is the option for automated scaling to meet the demands of an application's userbase. >>Source Iran Could use Bitcoin to get Around Sanctions Iran is looking to adopt Bitcoin and move to a more crypto-friendly atmosphere as a result of international sanctions. The Iranian Presidential Center for Strategic Studies released a report that suggests the country could get around sanctions by using digital currency. Coins like Bitcoin are less traceable than traditional fiat currencies and can be utilised to essentially outsmart sanctions while generating millions of dollars a day from mining. This means that the country could have a somewhat untraceable source of funds. >>Source Kentucky is Looking to Attract Miners Kentucky is making space for Bitcoin miners. The state is planning to offer cryptocurrency miners tax exemptions. This would lead to mining farms and miners looking to the state when starting up or moving operations. The bill received approval in the lower house and removes the 6% sales tax on power consumption for 4 years. Between July 2021 and June 2025, miners would be able to see a higher profit and lower costs. There is the potential for further tax incentives for mining farms through other bills that the Kentucky senate is looking to pass as well. >>Source [align=center][url=https://hackforums.net/member.php?action=profile&uid=4913576][img]https://i.imgur.com/uTDEFhy.png[/img][/url][/align] [b][color=white]A Mosquito’s Worst Nightmare[/color][/b] The war on disease-carrying insects has reached a new level as researchers have identified the active ingredient in catnip responsible for repelling insects. "We discovered that Catnip and its active ingredient Nepetalactone activate the irritant receptor TRPA1, an ancient pain receptor found in animals as diverse as flatworms, fruit flies, and humans," which is why it is so effective. Unlike other species, humans are not affected by “Nepetalactone”. The hope is that countries battling disease-carrying insects can use this information to decrease deaths and other risk factors. Experiments are still being conducted and in the future stronger and environmentally safe repellents may be based on the foundation of this study. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2021/03/210304145425.htm]>>Source[/url][/size][/i] [b][color=white]Invasion of the Miniature Drones [/color][/b] For years inventors have struggled with finding a solution to building mini drones, however, it seems the wait is finally over. The source of the problem was “large drones are usually powered by motors, but motors lose efficiency as you shrink them.” Makers of the drones were able to circumvent this by utilizing “actuators” that allow the drones to flap at a very high rate of speed. This will assist the drone if it bumps into a foreign object. The creators hope that first responders and farmers will be able to benefit from this technology. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2021/03/210303093505.htm]>>Source[/url][/size][/i] [b][color=white]Having a Blast[/color][/b] With the help of new technology, scientists are now able to calculate the temperatures of red supergiant stars. Until now it wasn’t possible due to interference. Researchers said, "chemical signatures known as absorption lines were the ideal candidates, but there was no single line that revealed the temperature alone. However, by looking at the ratio of two different but related lines -- those of iron -- we found the ratio itself related to temperature. And it did so in a consistent and predictable way." Gathering more data on red supergiants is important due to the nature of type II supernovas, which are responsible for distributing the necessary elements for life throughout the universe. At this time there is no way to predict when a supernova will occur, however, researchers are hopeful that this method will be used to accurately predict when one will occur in the future.
